stem: Which of these sentences could best follow sentence 13 and provide additional support for the main idea of the third paragraph (sentences 10–14)?

options.label: F
options.text: In his research Goddio has collaborated with archaeologists, Egyptologists, historians, geologists, geophysicists, computer engineers, and others.

options.label: G
options.text: The remains of more than 60 ships, at least 700 ancient anchors, gold coins, and bronze, lead, and stone weights indicate that the city was a major trading port in the eastern Mediterranean.

options.label: H
options.text: The city was probably an important entry port for trade into Egypt before it sank into the Mediterranean Sea so many centuries ago.

options.label: J
options.text: Some accounts suggest that both Helen of Troy and her lover, Paris, were stranded on the island for a period of time as they hid from her Greek husband.
